preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of each string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
Each character in the string S must be a lowercase English letter.
The total length of all strings S across all test cases must not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to make the string S a palindrome, the output must be 'NO'.
If it is possible to make the string S a palindrome, the output must be 'YES' followed by the minimum number of operations required.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= T <= 10000","description":"The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= N <= 10**5","description":"The length of each string S must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"all(c.islower() for c in S)","description":"Each character in the string S must be a lowercase English letter."},{"id":"P4","expression":"sum(N for _ in range(T)) <= 10**6","description":"The total length of all strings S across all test cases must not exceed 1,000,000."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == 'NO'","description":"If it is impossible to make the string S a palindrome, the output must be 'NO'."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"stdout == 'YES\\n' + str(operations)","description":"If it is possible to make the string S a palindrome, the output must be 'YES' followed by the minimum number of operations required."}],"invariants":[]}
